```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

########Simple 

# Step 1: Define players by nflId
rushers_of_interest <- c(44813, 47889, 47785) 

# Step 2: Get snap frame IDs
snap_frames <- week7 %>%
  filter(event == "ball_snap") %>%
  select(gameId, playId, snap_frame = frameId)

# Step 3: Get QB positions at snap
qb_snap <- week7 %>%
  filter(event == "ball_snap", officialPosition == "QB") %>%
  select(gameId, playId, qb_x = x, qb_y = y)

# Step 4: Build rusher paths
rusher_paths <- week7 %>%
  filter(nflId %in% rushers_of_interest) %>%
  left_join(snap_frames, by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(qb_snap, by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  filter(frameId >= snap_frame) %>%
  mutate(
    frame_rel  = frameId - snap_frame,
    rel_x      = x - qb_x,
    rel_y      = y - qb_y,
    play_id_key = paste(gameId, playId, nflId, sep = "_")
  )

# Step 5: Average path per player
avg_path <- rusher_paths %>%
  group_by(nflId, frame_rel) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rel_x = mean(rel_x, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_rel_y = mean(rel_y, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 6: Plot
ggplot(rusher_paths, aes(x = rel_x, y = rel_y, group = play_id_key)) +
  geom_path(alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 0.4, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_path(
    data = avg_path,
    aes(x = avg_rel_x, y = avg_rel_y, group = nflId),
    color = "white", linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "dashed",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = 0, y = 0), color = "yellow",
             size = 4, shape = 4, stroke = 1.5,
             inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ nflId) +
  labs(
    title = "Pass Rush Trajectories Relative to QB",
    subtitle = "Dashed white line = average path | X = QB position at snap",
    x = "Horizontal Distance from QB (yards)",
    y = "Depth from QB (yards)"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_dark() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# Step 1: Define players by nflId
rushers_of_interest <- c(44813, 47889, 47785)  

# Step 2: Get snap frame IDs
snap_frames <- week7 %>%
  filter(event == "ball_snap") %>%
  select(gameId, playId, snap_frame = frameId)

# Step 3: Get QB positions at snap
qb_snap <- week7 %>%
  filter(event == "ball_snap", officialPosition == "QB") %>%
  select(gameId, playId, qb_x = x, qb_y = y)

# Step 4: Derive pressure from events in week7
pressure_plays <- pffScouting %>%
  filter(event %in% c("pff_hit", "pff_sack", "pff_hurry")) %>%
  distinct(gameId, playId) %>%
  mutate(pressure = 1)

# Step 5: Build rusher paths
rusher_paths <- week7 %>%
  filter(nflId %in% rushers_of_interest) %>%
  left_join(snap_frames, by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(qb_snap, by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(pressure_plays, by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  mutate(pressure = replace_na(pressure, 0)) %>%
  filter(frameId >= snap_frame) %>%
  mutate(
    frame_rel   = frameId - snap_frame,
    rel_x       = x - qb_x,
    rel_y       = y - qb_y,
    play_id_key = paste(gameId, playId, nflId, sep = "_"),
    outcome     = ifelse(pressure == 1, "Pressure", "No Pressure")
  )

# Step 6: Average path per player
avg_path <- rusher_paths %>%
  group_by(nflId, frame_rel) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rel_x = mean(rel_x, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_rel_y = mean(rel_y, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 7: Plot
ggplot(rusher_paths, aes(x = rel_x, y = rel_y, group = play_id_key, color = outcome)) +
  geom_path(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_path(
    data = avg_path,
    aes(x = avg_rel_x, y = avg_rel_y, group = nflId),
    color = "white", linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "dashed",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = 0, y = 0), color = "yellow",
    size = 4, shape = 4, stroke = 1.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Pressure" = "red", "No Pressure" = "blue")) +
  facet_wrap(~ nflId) +
  labs(
    title = "Pass Rush Trajectories Relative to QB",
    subtitle = "Dashed white line = average path | X = QB position at snap",
    x = "Horizontal Distance from QB (yards)",
    y = "Depth from QB (yards)",
    color = "Outcome"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_dark() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r chunk}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

# ============================================================
#  CHANGE THESE to the nflIds you want to focus on
# ============================================================
rushers_of_interest <- c(44813, 47889, 47785)   # swap in any nflIds
# ============================================================

# Step 1: Get pass rusher nflIds from scouting data
pass_rushers <- pffScouting %>%
  filter(pff_role == "Pass Rush") %>%
  select(gameId, playId, nflId, pff_hit, pff_hurry, pff_sack) %>%
  distinct()

# Step 2: Derive pressure from scouting columns
pressure_plays <- pass_rushers %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  summarise(
    pressure = as.integer(any(pff_hit == 1 | pff_hurry == 1 | pff_sack == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 3: Get snap frames
snap_frames <- week7 %>%
  filter(event == "ball_snap") %>%
  select(gameId, playId, snap_frame = frameId)

# Step 4: Get QB position at snap
qb_snap <- week7 %>%
  filter(event == "ball_snap", officialPosition == "QB") %>%
  select(gameId, playId, qb_x = x, qb_y = y)

# Step 5: Build rusher paths — filtered to only your players of interest
rusher_paths <- week7 %>%
  filter(nflId %in% rushers_of_interest) %>%
  left_join(snap_frames,    by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(qb_snap,        by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(pressure_plays, by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  mutate(pressure = replace_na(pressure, 0)) %>%
  filter(frameId >= snap_frame) %>%
  mutate(
    frame_rel = frameId - snap_frame,
    rel_x = x - qb_x,
    rel_y = y - qb_y,
    rel_x = ifelse(playDirection == "left", -rel_x, rel_x),
    rel_y = ifelse(playDirection == "left", -rel_y, rel_y),
    play_id_key = paste(gameId, playId, nflId, sep = "_"),
    outcome = ifelse(pressure == 1, "Pressure", "No Pressure")
  )

rusher_paths <- rusher_paths %>%
  left_join(players %>% select(nflId, displayName), by = "nflId")

# Step 6: Average path per rusher
avg_path <- rusher_paths %>%
  group_by(nflId, frame_rel) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rel_x = mean(rel_x, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_rel_y = mean(rel_y, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

avg_path <- avg_path %>%
  left_join(players %>% select(nflId, displayName), by = "nflId")

# Step 7: Plot
ggplot(rusher_paths, aes(x = rel_y, y = rel_x, group = play_id_key, color = outcome)) +
  geom_path(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_path(
    data = avg_path,
    aes(x = avg_rel_y, y = avg_rel_x, group = factor(nflId)),
    color = "white", linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "dashed",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = 0, y = 0), color = "yellow",
    size = 4, shape = 4, stroke = 1.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Pressure" = "#E74C3C", "No Pressure" = "#3498DB")) +
  facet_wrap(~ displayName) +
  labs(
    title = "Pass Rush Trajectories Relative to QB, Week 7",
    subtitle = "Dashed white line = average path | X = QB position at snap",
    x = "Horizontal Distance from QB (yards)",
    y = "Depth from QB (yards)",
    color = "Outcome"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_dark() +

    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

rushers_of_interest <- c(44813, 47889, 47785)  

# Step 1: Get pass rusher nflIds from scouting data
pass_rushers <- pffScouting %>%
  filter(pff_role == "Pass Rush") %>%
  select(gameId, playId, nflId, pff_hit, pff_hurry, pff_sack) %>%
  distinct()

# Step 2: Derive pressure from scouting columns
pressure_plays <- pass_rushers %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  summarise(
    pressure = as.integer(any(pff_hit == 1 | pff_hurry == 1 | pff_sack == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Step 3: Get snap frames
snap_frames <- week7 %>%
  filter(event == "ball_snap") %>%
  select(gameId, playId, snap_frame = frameId)

# Step 4: Get QB position at snap
qb_snap <- week7 %>%
  filter(event == "ball_snap", officialPosition == "QB") %>%
  select(gameId, playId, qb_x = x, qb_y = y)

# Step 5: Define end of pass rush window
# Ends at whichever comes first:
# - QB releases ball (pass_forward, qb_spike)
# - QB gets sacked (sack)
# - QB leaves pocket (qb_scramble)
# - 3 second max (30 frames at 10fps)
end_events <- c("pass_forward", "autoevent_passforward", "pass_arrived", "qb_sack", "autoevent_passinterrupted", "pass_tipped", "qb_strip_sack", "pass_outcome_caught")

end_frames <- week7 %>%
  filter(event %in% end_events) %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  summarise(end_frame = min(frameId), .groups = "drop")  # take earliest end event

# Step 6: Build rusher paths with window applied
rusher_paths <- week7 %>%
  filter(nflId %in% rushers_of_interest) %>%
  left_join(snap_frames,    by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(end_frames,     by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(qb_snap,        by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(pressure_plays, by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  mutate(
    pressure  = replace_na(pressure, 0),
    # Cap end frame at 30 frames (3 seconds) past snap
    end_frame = pmin(end_frame, snap_frame + 30, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  # Apply the window: only frames between snap and end event
  filter(frameId >= snap_frame, frameId <= end_frame) %>%
  mutate(
    frame_rel   = frameId - snap_frame,
    rel_x       = x - qb_x,
    rel_y       = y - qb_y,
    rel_x       = ifelse(playDirection == "left", -rel_x, rel_x),
    rel_y       = ifelse(playDirection == "left", -rel_y, rel_y),
    play_id_key = paste(gameId, playId, nflId, sep = "_"),
    outcome     = ifelse(pressure == 1, "Pressure", "No Pressure")
  )

 rusher_paths <- rusher_paths %>%
  left_join(players %>% select(nflId, displayName), by = "nflId")

# Step 7: Average path per rusher
avg_path <- rusher_paths %>%
  group_by(nflId, frame_rel) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_rel_x = mean(rel_x, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_rel_y = mean(rel_y, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

avg_path <- avg_path %>%
  left_join(players %>% select(nflId, displayName), by = "nflId")

rusher_starts <- rusher_paths %>%
  filter(frame_rel == 0)

# Step 8: Plot
ggplot(rusher_paths, aes(x = rel_y, y = rel_x, group = play_id_key, color = outcome)) +
  geom_path(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 1.2) +
  # Starting position marker
  geom_point(
    data = rusher_starts,
    aes(x = rel_y, y = rel_x, color = outcome),
    size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 0.8,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # Average path
  geom_path(
    data = avg_path,
    aes(x = avg_rel_y, y = avg_rel_x, group = factor(nflId)),
    color = "white", linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "dashed",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  # QB marker
  geom_point(
    aes(x = 0, y = 0), color = "yellow",
    size = 4, shape = 4, stroke = 1.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Pressure" = "#E74C3C", "No Pressure" = "#3498DB")) +
  facet_wrap(~ displayName) +
  labs(
    title = "Pass Rush Trajectories Relative to QB, Week 7",
    subtitle = "Dashed white line = average path | X = QB | Circle = rusher start position",
    x = "Horizontal Distance from QB (yards)",
    y = "Depth from QB (yards)",
    color = "Outcome"
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_dark() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(bslib)

setwd("/Users/mateoshelton/Desktop/BSA")

# ── LOAD DATA ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
week1 <- read.csv("week1.csv")
week2 <- read.csv("week2.csv")
week3 <- read.csv("week3.csv")
week4 <- read.csv("week4.csv")
week5 <- read.csv("week5.csv")
week6 <- read.csv("week6.csv")
week7 <- read.csv("week7.csv")   # was missing — caused object error
week8 <- read.csv("week8.csv")   # was missing — caused object error

scouting <- read.csv("pffScoutingData.csv")
players  <- read.csv("players.csv")

# ── PRE-PROCESS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Combine all weeks
all_weeks <- bind_rows(
  week1 %>% mutate(week = 1),
  week2 %>% mutate(week = 2),
  week3 %>% mutate(week = 3),
  week4 %>% mutate(week = 4),
  week5 %>% mutate(week = 5),
  week6 %>% mutate(week = 6),
  week7 %>% mutate(week = 7),
  week8 %>% mutate(week = 8)
)

# Identify QBs from scouting — tracking has no officialPosition column
qb_ids <- scouting %>%
  filter(pff_positionLinedUp == "QB") %>%
  distinct(nflId) %>%
  pull(nflId)

# Pressure lookup
pressure_plays <- scouting %>%
  filter(pff_role == "Pass Rush") %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  summarise(
    pressure = as.integer(any(pff_hit == 1 | pff_hurry == 1 | pff_sack == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Snap frames — handle both snap event label variants
snap_frames <- all_weeks %>%
  filter(event %in% c("ball_snap", "autoevent_ballsnap")) %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  summarise(snap_frame = min(frameId), .groups = "drop")

# QB positions at snap — use qb_ids since no officialPosition column
qb_snap <- all_weeks %>%
  filter(event %in% c("ball_snap", "autoevent_ballsnap"), nflId %in% qb_ids) %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  slice_min(frameId, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(gameId, playId, qb_x = x, qb_y = y)

# End of pass rush window — qb_sack is the correct label in this dataset
end_events <- c(
  "pass_forward", "autoevent_passforward",
  "qb_sack", "qb_strip_sack",
  "qb_scramble", "qb_spike"
)

end_frames <- all_weeks %>%
  filter(event %in% end_events) %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  summarise(end_frame = min(frameId), .groups = "drop")

# Pass rusher nflIds
pass_rusher_ids <- scouting %>%
  filter(pff_role == "Pass Rush") %>%
  pull(nflId) %>%
  unique()

# Build rusher paths — join displayName cleanly from players
all_rusher_paths <- all_weeks %>%
  filter(nflId %in% pass_rusher_ids) %>%
  left_join(snap_frames,    by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(end_frames,     by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(qb_snap,        by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(pressure_plays, by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(players %>% select(nflId, displayName), by = "nflId") %>%  # join name here
  mutate(
    pressure  = replace_na(pressure, 0),
    end_frame = pmin(end_frame, snap_frame + 30, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(snap_frame),
    !is.na(qb_x),
    frameId >= snap_frame,
    frameId <= end_frame
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    frame_rel   = frameId - snap_frame,
    rel_x       = x - qb_x,
    rel_y       = y - qb_y,
    rel_x       = ifelse(playDirection == "left", -rel_x, rel_x),
    rel_y       = ifelse(playDirection == "left", -rel_y, rel_y),
    play_id_key = paste(gameId, playId, nflId, sep = "_"),
    outcome     = ifelse(pressure == 1, "Pressure", "No Pressure")
  ) %>%
  filter(abs(rel_x) <= 15, abs(rel_y) <= 15)

# Player lookup for dropdown
player_lookup <- all_rusher_paths %>%
  distinct(nflId, displayName) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(is.na(displayName), as.character(nflId), displayName)) %>%
  arrange(label)

max_frame <- max(all_rusher_paths$frame_rel, na.rm = TRUE)

# ── UI ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

ui <- fluidPage(
  theme = bs_theme(bootswatch = "morph"),

  titlePanel("Pass Rush Trajectory Explorer"),

  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      width = 3,

      textInput(
        inputId     = "player_search",
        label       = "Search Pass Rushers",
        placeholder = "Type a name...",
        width       = "100%"
      ),
        uiOutput("player_checkboxes"),

      checkboxGroupInput(
        inputId  = "selected_weeks",
        label    = "Select Weeks",
        choices  = sort(unique(all_rusher_paths$week)),
        selected = sort(unique(all_rusher_paths$week))
      ),

      sliderInput(
        inputId = "frame_slider",
        label   = "Frame (relative to snap)",
        min     = 0,
        max     = max_frame,
        value   = max_frame,
        step    = 1,
        animate = animationOptions(interval = 150, loop = FALSE)
      ),

      hr(),
      helpText("Each line = one play."),
      helpText("Hit ▶ on slider to animate.")
    ),

    mainPanel(
      width = 9,
      plotOutput("spaghetti_plot", height = "900px")
    )
  )
)

# ── SERVER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  filtered_paths <- reactive({
    req(input$selected_players, input$selected_weeks)

    all_rusher_paths %>%
      filter(
        nflId     %in% as.integer(input$selected_players),
        week      %in% as.integer(input$selected_weeks),
        frame_rel <= input$frame_slider
      )
  })

  filtered_avg <- reactive({
    filtered_paths() %>%
      group_by(nflId, displayName, frame_rel) %>%
      summarise(
        avg_rel_x = mean(rel_x, na.rm = TRUE),
        avg_rel_y = mean(rel_y, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })
  
  filtered_player_list <- reactive({
    search <- trimws(input$player_search)
    if (nchar(search) == 0) {
      player_lookup
    } else {
      player_lookup %>% filter(grepl(search, label, ignore.case = TRUE))
    }
  })

    output$player_checkboxes <- renderUI({
      checkboxGroupInput(
       inputId  = "selected_players",
        label    = NULL,
        choices  = setNames(filtered_player_list()$nflId, filtered_player_list()$label),
       selected = isolate(input$selected_players)
    )
  })

  rusher_starts <- reactive({
    filtered_paths() %>% filter(frame_rel == 0)
  })

  output$spaghetti_plot <- renderPlot({

    validate(
      need(nrow(filtered_paths()) > 0, "No data found for selected players/weeks.")
    )

    ggplot(filtered_paths(),
           aes(x = rel_x, y = rel_y, group = play_id_key, color = outcome)) +

      geom_path(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 1.0) +

      geom_point(
        data = rusher_starts(),
        aes(x = rel_x, y = rel_y, color = outcome),
        size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 0.8,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +

      geom_path(
        data = filtered_avg(),
        aes(x = avg_rel_x, y = avg_rel_y, group = factor(nflId)),
        color = "white", linewidth = 1.3, linetype = "dashed",
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +

      geom_point(
        aes(x = 0, y = 0),
        color = "yellow", size = 4, shape = 4, stroke = 1.5,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +

      scale_color_manual(values = c("Pressure" = "#E74C3C", "No Pressure" = "#3498DB")) +
      facet_wrap(~ displayName) +
      labs(
        title    = paste0("Pass Rush Trajectories — Frame ", input$frame_slider,
                          " (", round(input$frame_slider / 10, 1), "s post-snap)"),
        subtitle = "Dashed white = avg path | X = QB | Circle = rusher start",
        x        = "Horizontal Distance from QB (yards)",
        y        = "Depth from QB (yards)",
        color    = "Outcome"
      ) +
      coord_fixed() +
      theme_dark() +
      theme(
        strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)
      )
  })
}

# ── LAUNCH ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

```

```{r}
  week6 %>% mutate(week = 6),
  week7 %>% mutate(week = 7),
  week8 %>% mutate(week = 8)
)

qb_ids <- scouting %>%
  filter(pff_positionLinedUp == "QB") %>%
  distinct(nflId) %>%
  pull(nflId)

designated_pass_rusher_ids <- players %>%
  filter(officialPosition %in% c("DE", "DT", "OLB", "NT")) %>%
  pull(nflId) %>%
  unique()

pressure_plays <- scouting %>%
  filter(pff_role == "Pass Rush") %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  summarise(
    pressure = as.integer(any(pff_hit == 1 | pff_hurry == 1 | pff_sack == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

snap_frames <- all_weeks %>%
  filter(event %in% c("ball_snap", "autoevent_ballsnap")) %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  summarise(snap_frame = min(frameId), .groups = "drop")

qb_snap <- all_weeks %>%
  filter(event %in% c("ball_snap", "autoevent_ballsnap"), nflId %in% qb_ids) %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  slice_min(frameId, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(gameId, playId, qb_x = x, qb_y = y)

end_events <- c(
  "pass_forward", "autoevent_passforward",
  "qb_sack", "qb_strip_sack",
  "qb_scramble", "qb_spike"
)

end_frames <- all_weeks %>%
  filter(event %in% end_events) %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  summarise(end_frame = min(frameId), .groups = "drop")

all_rusher_paths <- all_weeks %>%
  filter(nflId %in% designated_pass_rusher_ids) %>%
  filter(nflId %in% (scouting %>%
           filter(pff_role == "Pass Rush") %>%
           pull(nflId) %>% unique())) %>%
  left_join(snap_frames,    by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(end_frames,     by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(qb_snap,        by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(pressure_plays, by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(players %>% select(nflId, displayName), by = "nflId") %>%
  mutate(
    pressure  = replace_na(pressure, 0),
    end_frame = pmin(end_frame, snap_frame + 30, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(snap_frame),
    !is.na(qb_x),
    frameId >= snap_frame,
    frameId <= end_frame
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    frame_rel   = frameId - snap_frame,
    rel_x       = x - qb_x,
    rel_y       = y - qb_y,
    rel_x       = ifelse(playDirection == "left", -rel_x, rel_x),
    rel_y       = ifelse(playDirection == "left", -rel_y, rel_y),
    play_id_key = paste(gameId, playId, nflId, sep = "_"),
    outcome     = ifelse(pressure == 1, "Pressure", "No Pressure")
  ) %>%
  filter(abs(rel_x) <= 15, abs(rel_y) <= 15)

player_lookup <- all_rusher_paths %>%
  distinct(nflId, displayName) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(is.na(displayName), as.character(nflId), displayName)) %>%
  arrange(label)

max_frame <- max(all_rusher_paths$frame_rel, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#SERVER

server <- function(input, output, session) {

frame_val <- reactive({
  input$frame_slider
}) %>% throttle(150)   # only update every 150ms instead of every tick

filtered_paths <- reactive({
  req(input$selected_players, input$selected_weeks)

  all_rusher_paths %>%
    filter(
      nflId     %in% as.integer(input$selected_players),
      week      %in% as.integer(input$selected_weeks),
      frame_rel <= frame_val()          # use throttled value here
    )
})

  filtered_avg <- reactive({
    filtered_paths() %>%
      group_by(nflId, displayName, frame_rel) %>%
      summarise(
        avg_rel_x = mean(rel_x, na.rm = TRUE),
        avg_rel_y = mean(rel_y, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })

  rusher_starts <- reactive({
    filtered_paths() %>% filter(frame_rel == 0)
  })

  output$spaghetti_plot <- renderPlot({

    validate(
      need(nrow(filtered_paths()) > 0, "No data found for selected players/weeks.")
    )

    ggplot(filtered_paths(),
           aes(x = -rel_y, y = rel_x,        # flipped 180 degrees from previous
               group = play_id_key, color = outcome)) +

      geom_path(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 1.0) +

      geom_point(
        data = rusher_starts(),
        aes(x = -rel_y, y = rel_x, color = outcome),
        size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 0.8,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +

      geom_path(
        data = filtered_avg(),
        aes(x = -avg_rel_y, y = avg_rel_x, group = factor(nflId)),
        color = "black", linewidth = 1.3, linetype = "dashed",
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +

      geom_point(
        aes(x = 0, y = 0),
        color = "green", size = 4, shape = 4, stroke = 1.5,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +

      scale_color_manual(values = c("Pressure" = "#E74C3C", "No Pressure" = "#3498DB")) +
      facet_wrap(~ displayName) +
      labs(
        title    = paste0("Pass Rush Trajectories — Frame ", input$frame_slider,
                          " (", round(input$frame_slider / 10, 1), "s post-snap)"),
        subtitle = "Dashed line = avg path | X = QB | Circle = rusher start",
        x        = "Sideline Distance from QB (yards)",
        y        = "Depth toward QB (yards)",
        color    = "Outcome"
      ) +
      coord_fixed() +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        strip.text      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle   = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
      )
  }, res = 96)
}
```

```{r}
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(bslib)
library(shinyWidgets)

setwd("/Users/mateoshelton/Desktop/BSA")

# ── LOAD DATA ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
week1 <- read.csv("week1.csv")
week2 <- read.csv("week2.csv")
week3 <- read.csv("week3.csv")
week4 <- read.csv("week4.csv")
week5 <- read.csv("week5.csv")
week6 <- read.csv("week6.csv")
week7 <- read.csv("week7.csv")
week8 <- read.csv("week8.csv")

scouting <- read.csv("pffScoutingData.csv")
players  <- read.csv("players.csv")
plays    <- read.csv("plays.csv")       # needed for down and quarter

# ── PRE-PROCESS ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

all_weeks <- bind_rows(
  week1 %>% mutate(week = 1),
  week2 %>% mutate(week = 2),
  week3 %>% mutate(week = 3),
  week4 %>% mutate(week = 4),
  week5 %>% mutate(week = 5),
  week6 %>% mutate(week = 6),
  week7 %>% mutate(week = 7),
  week8 %>% mutate(week = 8)
)

qb_ids <- scouting %>%
  filter(pff_positionLinedUp == "QB") %>%
  distinct(nflId) %>%
  pull(nflId)

designated_pass_rusher_ids <- players %>%
  filter(officialPosition %in% c("DE", "DT", "OLB", "NT")) %>%
  pull(nflId) %>%
  unique()

# Pressure lookup
pressure_plays <- scouting %>%
  filter(pff_role == "Pass Rush") %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  summarise(
    pressure = as.integer(any(pff_hit == 1 | pff_hurry == 1 | pff_sack == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

double_team_plays <- scouting %>%
  filter(pff_role == "Pass Block", !is.na(pff_nflIdBlockedPlayer)) %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId, pff_nflIdBlockedPlayer) %>%
  summarise(blockers_assigned = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(nflId = pff_nflIdBlockedPlayer) %>%
  mutate(double_teamed = blockers_assigned >= 2)

# Play result lookup — derived from tracking events
play_results <- all_weeks %>%
  filter(event %in% c(
    "pass_outcome_incomplete", "qb_sack",
    "qb_strip_sack", "qb_hit"
  )) %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  summarise(
    play_result = case_when(
      any(event %in% c("qb_sack", "qb_strip_sack")) ~ "Sack",
      any(event == "qb_hit")                         ~ "QB Hit",
      any(event == "pass_outcome_incomplete")        ~ "Incomplete Pass",
      TRUE                                           ~ "Other"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Down and quarter from plays.csv
play_context <- plays %>%
  select(gameId, playId, down, quarter)

# Snap frames
snap_frames <- all_weeks %>%
  filter(event %in% c("ball_snap", "autoevent_ballsnap")) %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  summarise(snap_frame = min(frameId), .groups = "drop")

# QB positions at snap
qb_snap <- all_weeks %>%
  filter(event %in% c("ball_snap", "autoevent_ballsnap"), nflId %in% qb_ids) %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  slice_min(frameId, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(players %>% select(nflId, displayName), by = "nflId") %>%
  select(gameId, playId, qb_x = x, qb_y = y, qb_name = displayName)

# End of pass rush window
end_events <- c(
  "pass_forward", "autoevent_passforward",
  "qb_sack", "qb_strip_sack",
  "qb_scramble", "qb_spike"
)

end_frames <- all_weeks %>%
  filter(event %in% end_events) %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId) %>%
  summarise(end_frame = min(frameId), .groups = "drop")

# Build rusher paths
all_rusher_paths <- all_weeks %>%
  filter(nflId %in% designated_pass_rusher_ids) %>%
  filter(nflId %in% (scouting %>%
           filter(pff_role == "Pass Rush") %>%
           pull(nflId) %>% unique())) %>%
  left_join(snap_frames,    by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(end_frames,     by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(qb_snap,        by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(pressure_plays, by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(play_results,   by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(play_context,   by = c("gameId", "playId")) %>%
  left_join(players %>% select(nflId, displayName), by = "nflId") %>%
  left_join(double_team_plays %>% select(gameId, playId, nflId, double_teamed),
          by = c("gameId", "playId", "nflId")) %>%
mutate(
  double_teamed = coalesce(double_teamed, FALSE),
  pressure      = coalesce(as.integer(pressure), 0L),
  end_frame     = pmin(end_frame, snap_frame + 30, na.rm = TRUE),
  play_result   = coalesce(play_result, "Other")
) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(snap_frame),
    !is.na(qb_x),
    frameId >= snap_frame,
    frameId <= end_frame
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    frame_rel   = frameId - snap_frame,
    rel_x       = x - qb_x,
    rel_y       = y - qb_y,
    rel_x       = ifelse(playDirection == "left", -rel_x, rel_x),
    rel_y       = ifelse(playDirection == "left", -rel_y, rel_y),
    play_id_key = paste(gameId, playId, nflId, sep = "_"),
    outcome = case_when(
      pressure == 1                      ~ "Pressure",
      double_teamed == TRUE              ~ "Double-Teamed",
      TRUE                               ~ "No Pressure"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(abs(rel_x) <= 15, abs(rel_y) <= 15)

player_lookup <- all_rusher_paths %>%
  distinct(nflId, displayName) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(is.na(displayName), as.character(nflId), displayName)) %>%
  arrange(label)

max_frame <- max(all_rusher_paths$frame_rel, na.rm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
          label    = "Weeks",

# ── SERVER ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  frame_val <- reactive({
    input$frame_slider
  }) %>% throttle(150)

  filtered_paths <- reactive({
    req(
      input$selected_players,
      input$selected_weeks,
      input$selected_downs,
      input$selected_quarters,
      input$selected_outcome,
      input$selected_result
    )

    all_rusher_paths %>%
      filter(
        nflId       %in% as.integer(input$selected_players),
        week        %in% as.integer(input$selected_weeks),
        down        %in% as.integer(input$selected_downs),
        quarter     %in% as.integer(input$selected_quarters),
        outcome     %in% input$selected_outcome,
        play_result %in% input$selected_result,
        frame_rel   <= frame_val()
      )
  })

  filtered_avg <- reactive({
    filtered_paths() %>%
      group_by(nflId, displayName, frame_rel) %>%
      summarise(
        avg_rel_x = mean(rel_x, na.rm = TRUE),
        avg_rel_y = mean(rel_y, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })

  rusher_starts <- reactive({
    filtered_paths() %>% filter(frame_rel == 0)
  })
  
  qb_label <- reactive({
  filtered_paths() %>%
    group_by(displayName) %>%
    summarise(
      qb_name = names(sort(table(qb_name), decreasing = TRUE))[1],
      .groups = "drop"
    )
})

  output$spaghetti_plot <- renderPlot({

    validate(
      need(nrow(filtered_paths()) > 0,
           "No data found for selected filters.")
    )

    ggplot(filtered_paths(),
           aes(x = -rel_y, y = rel_x,
               group = play_id_key, color = outcome)) +

      geom_path(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 1.0) +

      geom_point(
        data = rusher_starts(),
        aes(x = -rel_y, y = rel_x, color = outcome),
        size = 2, shape = 21, fill = "white", stroke = 0.8,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +

      geom_path(
        data = filtered_avg(),
        aes(x = -avg_rel_y, y = avg_rel_x, group = factor(nflId)),
        color = "white", linewidth = 1.3, linetype = "dashed",
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +

      geom_point(
        aes(x = 0, y = 0),
        color = "gold", size = 4, shape = 4, stroke = 1.5,
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +
      
      geom_text(
        data  = qb_label(),
        aes(x = 0, y = -1.4, label = qb_name),
        color = "gold", size = 3, fontface = "italic",
        inherit.aes = FALSE
      ) +

      scale_color_manual(
        values = c(
          "Pressure"      = "#E74C3C",
          "Double-Teamed" = "#F39C12",
          "No Pressure"   = "#3498DB"
         )
      ) +
      facet_wrap(~ displayName) +
      labs(
        title    = paste0("Pass Rush Trajectories — Frame ", input$frame_slider,
                          " (", round(input$frame_slider / 10, 1), "s post-snap)"),
        subtitle = "Dashed white = avg path | X = QB | Circle = rusher start",
        x        = "Sideline Distance from QB (yards)",
        y        = "Depth toward QB (yards)",
        color    = "Outcome"
      ) +
      coord_fixed() +
     theme_minimal() +
     theme(
      panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "#1C1C1C", color = NA),
      plot.background   = element_rect(fill = "#1C1C1C", color = NA),
      panel.grid.major  = element_line(color = "#3a3a3a"),
      panel.grid.minor  = element_line(color = "#2a2a2a"),
      strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "#2d2d2d", color = NA),
      strip.text        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "white"),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#1C1C1C"),
      legend.text       = element_text(color = "white"),
      legend.title      = element_text(color = "white"),
      axis.text         = element_text(color = "#aaaaaa"),
      axis.title        = element_text(color = "#cccccc"),
      plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5, color = "white"),
      plot.subtitle     = element_text(hjust = 0.5, color = "#aaaaaa"),
      legend.position   = "bottom"
)
  }, res = 96, bg = "#1C1C1C")

  outputOptions(output, "spaghetti_plot", suspendWhenHidden = FALSE)
}

# ── LAUNCH ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
```
